title: Design System: iTala Connect
scope: Public event pages (/events/[eventId]) only. Colour values are the default event theme; organisers replace them through the --ev-* tokens. Platform screens (home, login, admin) are not yet decided.

ev-on-accent.note: Computed black or white by readableOn(accent); never hand-picked.

divisionTokens.--div: Organiser-chosen division colour, set per element by divisionVars(); invalid values fall back to the default accent.
divisionTokens.--on-div: Computed black or white text for solid --div fills.

display.purpose: The event name, once per page. Uppercase, balanced.

score.purpose: Score numerals on a drawn court, sized by container query.

court-name.purpose: Court numbers only, like a floor stencil. Uppercase.

team-name.purpose: Team names in grid cells and stations.

label.purpose: Station terms such as Final and Up next. Uppercase.

strokes.name: line
strokes.purpose: All structural paint: court lines, outlines, over-paint, now line.

strokes.name: rule
strokes.purpose: Quiet separation: stations, grid hours, footer, final and awaiting cells.

strokes.name: emphasis
strokes.purpose: Chosen team's cells and underline on the court; focus outline.

strokes.name: over-paint
strokes.purpose: Active tab; final tick on grid cells.

strokes.name: baseline-tick
strokes.purpose: Final state closing both baselines of a drawn court.

strokes.name: dash
strokes.purpose: Up next on a drawn court.

motion.name: paint-in
motion.purpose: A changed score clips up from the floor.

motion.name: now-line
motion.purpose: The now line easing to its new position.

components.css: .ds-court-panel { --paint: var(--ev-accent, #FFCC00); --floor-tint: color-mix(in srgb, var(--paint) 5%, var(--ev-bg, #0D0D0D)); background: var(--ev-bg, #0D0D0D); color: var(--ev-text, #E0E0E0); padding: 1rem; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; max-width: 24rem; } .ds-court-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 1rem; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; } .ds-court-name { margin: 0; color: var(--ev-heading, #FFFFFF); font-family: 'Big Shoulders Stencil', 'Big Shoulders', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.75rem; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-court-status { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.375rem; margin: 0; color: var(--ev-muted, #888888); font-size: 0.875rem; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-court-status strong { color: var(--paint); } .ds-live { width: 0.5rem; height: 0.5rem; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--paint); } .ds-court { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 28 / 15; container-type: inline-size; } .ds-lines { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: visible; fill: none; stroke: var(--paint); stroke-width: 2px; } .ds-lines * { vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke; } .ds-floor { fill: var(--floor-tint); } .ds-key { fill: color-mix(in srgb, var(--div) 34%, var(--ev-bg, #0D0D0D)); } .ds-dot { fill: var(--paint); stroke: none; } .ds-name { position: absolute; top: 8%; width: 45%; margin: 0; color: var(--ev-heading, #FFFFFF); font-weight: 700; font-size: clamp(0.875rem, 4.3cqi, 1.3rem); line-height: 1.15; text-align: center; text-wrap: balance; } .ds-name.ds-l { left: 3%; } .ds-name.ds-r { right: 3%; } .ds-name span, .ds-score span { padding: 0 0.15em; background: var(--floor-tint); box-decoration-break: clone; } .ds-score { position: absolute; top: 38%; margin: 0; color: var(--ev-heading, #FFFFFF); font-family: 'Big Shoulders', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: min(15cqi, 5.5rem); line-height: 1; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-score.ds-l { left: 21%; right: 52%; text-align: center; } .ds-score.ds-r { left: 52%; right: 21%; text-align: center; }

components.css: .ds-cells { --paint: var(--ev-accent, #FFCC00); --bg: var(--ev-bg, #0D0D0D); --rule: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-muted, #888888) 38%, var(--bg)); display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 11rem); gap: 0.5rem; padding: 1rem; background: var(--bg); color: var(--ev-text, #E0E0E0); font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-cell { position: relative; display: grid; align-content: start; gap: 0.25rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.625rem 0.75rem; background: var(--bg); border: 2px dashed color-mix(in srgb, var(--paint) 55%, var(--bg)); border-radius: 2px; } .ds-cell[data-status='on-court'] { border-style: solid; border-color: var(--paint); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--paint) 13%, var(--bg)); } .ds-cell[data-status='final'] { border: 1px solid var(--rule); } .ds-cell[data-status='final']::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -1px; bottom: -1px; width: 2.25rem; height: 4px; background: var(--paint); } .ds-cell-label { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.375rem; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-sw { width: 0.625rem; height: 0.625rem; background: #E06040; } .ds-tag { justify-self: start; padding: 0 0.375rem; background: var(--paint); color: var(--ev-on-accent, #000000); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-status { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-team { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 0.5rem; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-team b { color: var(--ev-heading, #FFFFFF); font-family: 'Big Shoulders', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.25rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.css: .ds-tabs { background: var(--ev-bg, #0D0D0D); padding: 1rem; } .ds-tabs ul { display: flex; gap: 0.25rem; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; border-bottom: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-muted, #888888) 38%, var(--ev-bg, #0D0D0D)); } .ds-tabs a { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 0.875rem; margin-bottom: -2px; border-bottom: 4px solid transparent; color: var(--ev-muted, #888888); font-family: 'Big Shoulders', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.125rem; letter-spacing: 0.03em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-tabs li:first-child a { padding-left: 0; } .ds-tabs a:hover { color: var(--ev-text, #E0E0E0); } .ds-tabs a[aria-current='page'] { color: var(--ev-heading, #FFFFFF); border-bottom-color: var(--ev-accent, #FFCC00); } .ds-tabs a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ev-accent, #FFCC00); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Team Chips
components.description: Team picker chips outlined in division colour; selected fills with the division colour.
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 1rem; background: var(--ev-bg, #0D0D0D); } .ds-chip { min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 0.875rem; border: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--div) 70%, var(--ev-bg, #0D0D0D)); border-radius: 2px; background: transparent; color: var(--ev-text, #E0E0E0); font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-chip:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--div) 16%, var(--ev-bg, #0D0D0D)); } .ds-chip[aria-pressed='true'] { background: var(--div); border-color: var(--div); color: var(--on-div); font-weight: 700; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ev-accent, #FFCC00); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Finder Toggle
components.description: Phone-only outlined toggle with a drawn chevron that opens the team finder.
components.css: .ds-wrap { padding: 1rem; background: var(--ev-bg, #0D0D0D); max-width: 24rem; } .ds-toggle { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; width: 100%; min-height: 3rem; padding: 0 1rem; border: 2px solid var(--ev-accent, #FFCC00); border-radius: 2px; background: transparent; color: var(--ev-heading, #FFFFFF); font-family: 'Big Shoulders', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.25rem; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; } .ds-toggle::after { content: ''; width: 0.55rem; height: 0.55rem; border-right: 2px solid var(--ev-accent, #FFCC00); border-bottom: 2px solid var(--ev-accent, #FFCC00); rotate: 45deg; translate: 0 -0.15rem; transition: rotate 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-toggle:hover::after, .ds-toggle[aria-expanded='true']::after { rotate: 225deg; translate: 0 0.15rem; } .ds-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ev-accent, #FFCC00); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Button
components.description: Boxless action with a 2 px paint underline, such as Change team and Clear.
components.css: .ds-actions { display: flex; gap: 1.25rem; padding: 1rem; background: var(--ev-bg, #0D0D0D); } .ds-text-btn { min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; color: var(--ev-text, #E0E0E0); font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 2px; text-decoration-color: var(--ev-accent, #FFCC00); text-underline-offset: 0.3em; cursor: pointer; } .ds-text-btn:hover { color: var(--ev-heading, #FFFFFF); } .ds-text-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ev-accent, #FFCC00); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Score Input
components.description: Owner-only score entry; invalid switches to a dashed body-ink outline.
components.css: .ds-scores { display: flex; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 1rem; background: var(--ev-bg, #0D0D0D); } .ds-score-in { width: 3.75rem; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 0.375rem; border: 1px solid var(--ev-muted, #888888); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--ev-bg, #0D0D0D); color: var(--ev-heading, #FFFFFF); font-family: 'Big Shoulders', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.25rem; text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-score-in:invalid { border-color: var(--ev-text, #E0E0E0); border-style: dashed; } .ds-score-in:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ev-accent, #FFCC00); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
The public event page is the organiser's gym floor. The organiser's background colour is the floor, and their accent colour is the line paint. Every structure on the page is a flat painted line at court weight (2 px), and each court is drawn as a real court (FIBA proportions, centre line, centre circle, keys filled with a division-colour tint) carrying its live game: team names on each half, big score numerals, the court number stencilled above it. Space separates sections, not boxes. There is no glow, no gradient, no shadow and no wood-grain costume.

This document governs public event pages only (/events/[eventId]). Inside that route every colour comes from the organiser's five event colours (--ev-accent, --ev-bg, --ev-text, --ev-muted, --ev-heading), the derived --ev-on-accent, and per-element division colours (--div, --on-div). The hex values in the frontmatter are the default event theme a new event starts with, not a brand palette. The only iTala element on an event page is the small "Powered by iTala Connect" footer.

iTala Connect platform screens (home, login, admin): not yet decided. They will use the iTala logo palette (navy, teal, lime) in a later design round.

The page is dense but calm: answer first (time, court, teams, score), readable at a glance in a bright gym on a mid-range phone, working from 360 px wide with 44 px touch targets. Copy is NZ English, dates DD/MM/YYYY, times "7:00 pm", in the event's time zone.
keyCharacteristics: Organiser colours only, applied as paint on the organiser's floor.
Constant 2 px paint lines; quiet 1 px rules for secondary separation.
State carried by stroke and by words: solid is on court, dashed is up next, a closed baseline tick is final.
Tall condensed athletic lettering (Big Shoulders) for numerals and headings, stencil cut for court numbers, Archivo for names and body.
One moving mark (the "now" line) plus a brief paint-in when a score changes.

rules.name: The Organiser's Paint Rule
rules.body: Inside /events/[eventId] every colour is an --ev-* token, a division token, or a color-mix of them. No hex literals, no Tailwind colour utilities, and no --brand-* token ever applies there.

rules.name: The Never Colour Alone Rule
rules.body: Every state that has a colour also has words and a stroke pattern ("On court", "Final", "Awaiting score", "Up next"). A division is named next to its swatch. An organiser palette with poor contrast must still read.

rules.name: The Tabular Numerals Rule
rules.body: Every score, time and date uses font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums so live changes never shift the layout.

rules.name: The Stencil Is For Courts Rule
rules.body: Big Shoulders Stencil marks court numbers only, like a floor stencil. It is never used for headings, scores or body.

rules.name: The Flat Paint Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow, no glow, no gradient, no texture. If something needs emphasis, give it heavier paint or a tint, not a lift.

rules.name: The Floor Patch Rule
rules.body: Lettering that sits on a drawn court sits on a patch of Floor Tint, so painted lines never cross a name or a score.

rules.name: The Two Pixel Rule
rules.body: Paint is 2 px. Anything thicker is a deliberate state signal from the list above, never decoration.

rules.name: The Stroke Carries State Rule
rules.body: Solid paint is on court. Dashed paint (7 on, 5 off on the court; CSS dashed on cells) is up next. A closed baseline tick is final. Faded paint is a court that has finished or has no more games. Awaiting score is a quiet 1 px outline with no tick.

dos: Do read every colour on an event page from --ev-*, --div or --on-div, deriving tints with color-mix(in srgb, ... , var(--ev-bg)).
Do draw structure with 2 px paint lines and separate sections with space.
Do pair every state with words and a stroke pattern: solid on court, dashed up next, baseline tick for final.
Do use Big Shoulders for numerals and headings, the stencil cut for court numbers only, Archivo for names and body, all with tabular numerals for scores and times.
Do put lettering that crosses court lines on a Floor Tint patch.
Do keep touch targets at least 2.75rem, make wide grids scroll inside themselves, and check the layout at 360 px.
Do check a new surface against a second organiser palette, including a light floor, before calling it done.
Do write dates as DD/MM/YYYY and times as "7:00 pm", in NZ English, with "-" as the only dash.
donts: Don't use --brand-* tokens, iTala logo colours or hard-coded hex values inside /events/[eventId]; the only iTala element is the "Powered by iTala Connect" footer.
Don't add shadows, glows, gradients, wood grain or other textures.
Don't put games or sections in filled cards or panels; a game is an outline on the floor.
Don't add another moving mark beyond the now line and the score paint-in.
Don't show a game clock, period or quarter; the mobile app owns those.
Don't round corners beyond 2px, except the circles a court actually has.
Don't treat this document as the platform screen system; that palette and type are not yet decided.
